Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You study the object until its small strangenesses begin to form a language you understand.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
Ten minutes.
Target / range / shape
One accessible magical item; 10 minutes
Duration
The result applies when the stated activity is complete; information and earned progress persist.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Pay the printed action and any full activity time for each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Weak: learn broad purpose. Standard: learn function and activation requirements. Strong: also reveal any curse and its activation. No recipe or waived prerequisites.
